detail: PRD stop condition required a complete coverage manifest. Documentation and practitioner evidence establish that no Notion integration can enumerate its own grant, that search is documented non-exhaustive, and that search terminates near 11,200 objects.
Byte-stable-after-timestamp-removal is untestable. Signed S3 URLs regenerate per request and carry a signature timestamp removal does not touch.
ADR-0001 adopted ESLint without a survey. A survey found ESLint solves one of five hard problems: identity, output contract, suppression lifecycle and incompleteness do not transfer.

72-hour API proof displaced as the next gate by a demand test. Two sweeps agree buildability is the smaller risk: seven of eight rules are instructable to a Notion Custom Agent today, and deterministic linters in every surveyed category monetize at zero.

CONTEXT.md declared itself canonical while omitting the primary user, the job, the finding contract, the exit codes, the kill criteria, the fourteen acceptance tests and the edge-case list, all of which existed only in the input it declared non-authoritative.

Two added: no team found that must prove a structural claim to a third party; Notion ships first-party coverage certification. One corrected: completeness is measured against declared roots, not the workspace.

PRODUCT.md asserted that no SARIF object expresses analysis scope or coverage. Verified against the machine-readable schema: result.kind (six values including notApplicable), invocation.executionSuccessful, invocation.toolExecutionNotifications and artifact.roles analysisTarget all exist and are normative. The true gap is narrower and is the run-level aggregate only.

ADR-0003 adopted the OSCAL observation/finding split. OSCAL defines no outcome value for not-assessed, not-applicable or unable-to-assess; finding-target status/@state is a closed binary of satisfied and not-satisfied. The incomplete outcome cannot be inherited from OSCAL and must be defined. XCCDF is the better donor. The adjacent reason and type vocabularies carry allow-other, so this is a definitional absence and not a prohibition.

Four scouts independently reached ISA 705, which models the outcome as nature crossed with pervasiveness rather than as a flat enum. XCCDF has run nine result values since 2005 and excludes non-verdicts from scoring. The project enum conflates notapplicable with notselected and notchecked with error. Scope exclusion is declared before a run; evidence unavailability is discovered during it, so inapplicable belongs in the scope declaration and not in the outcome enum.

The 10/25/50/100 requests-per-second plan-tier figures are not published by Notion and came from third-party blogs. Notion documents an average of three requests per second per connection and states the workspace ceiling is scaled to plan with no tier table. At 3 req/s the three-minute warm-scan kill criterion is a budget of roughly 540 requests.

Notion admin content search is real, Enterprise-only, reaches private pages and exports CSV. Verification established it is a search rather than an enumeration: the documented entry point is searching by page ID, title or content. Notion ships admin lookup over private content, not coverage enumeration. The wedge survives, conditional on the product enumerating rather than looking up.

S001 recorded that Reddit was unreachable and treated the obvious recruiting venues as gone. Two research agents could not load Reddit; the operator can and has. A free structural diagnosis posted publicly on Reddit in a single response converted a stranger into a scoped call with a Director of Engineering. The tooling limitation had been recorded as a market fact.

The ISO 19011:2018 text used in the sweep was read from a site hosting a complete unauthorised copy including its intact copyright page, which forbids posting on the internet. The wording and clause numbers are genuine and were verified against it. The URL must never appear in a published artifact. The same applies to the squarespace-hosted ISA 705 mirror.

ADR-0005 accepted. Outcome becomes a pair: conformity (conforms|violates, absent when nothing was evaluated) times evidence sufficiency (sufficient|unreached|undecidable). `inapplicable` deleted from the outcome enum — operator exclusion moves to the scope declaration, precondition mismatch becomes an applicability filter in the manifest. Report disposition unqualified|qualified|disclaimed, where a disclaimed report renders no summary verdict. Coverage manifest becomes a five-stage funnel. This unblocks the 72-hour proof, which was waiting on the outcome model to know what it must measure.

The claim 'no SARIF object expresses analysis scope or coverage' is refuted against sarif-schema-2.1.0.json. Four normative primitives exist: result.kind, invocation.executionSuccessful, invocation.toolExecutionNotifications, artifact.roles analysisTarget. The true gap is the run-level coverage aggregate only. Corrected in PRODUCT.md. Deliberately NOT corrected in ADR-0002 and ADR-0003, which are immutable records superseded by reference.

Two of the S002 checkpoint's EXACT NEXT STEPS were wrong about the repository. Step 2 named PRODUCT.md as the sole site of the refuted SARIF claim; grep found it in three files, including ADR-0003 Consequences in its strongest form. Step 2 also instructed deleting 10/25/50/100 req/s figures 'wherever they appear'; those figures appear in no canonical doc, making that half of the instruction a no-op. Neither was a blocker, but both would have produced an incomplete correction if executed literally. The claim-verification step paid for itself on its first run in this project.

docs/research/notion-api-practice.md 5.2 rated selective revocation (C) — community reports, no reproduced primary write-up. Observed directly in the Notion UI on wl-revoke-child. Dialog reads verbatim: 'Disconnect workspace-lint-proof and unlink share settings from parent page? This page will no longer inherit share settings from its parent. Admins can still restore settings later.' Notion models it as breaking inheritance, not as a per-child deny, and an admin can restore it. Consequence: unreached inside a declared root IS reachable by permissions, not only by rate limits and pagination, so ADR-0005's evidence-sufficiency axis keeps its full range and no superseding ADR is required. The API consequence — does the parent still list a child_page block while the child 404s — remains open and belongs to the proof.

ADR-0002 decision 4 requires that the absence of request_status from a paginated list response be treated as a hard error. Observed against the live API at Notion-Version 2026-03-11: request_status is absent from every normal response — data_sources query with has_more true, block children with has_more true, and block children with has_more false. Primary source developers.notion.com/reference/query-a-data-source documents the field as conditional, emitted when the 10,000-result cap is hit, and instructs a positive test: check request_status.type === incomplete. Implemented literally, decision 4 makes every scan of every healthy workspace a hard error. The intent was right and the mechanism is backwards. ADR-0002 is not edited; a superseding decision is required before scan code is written.

gate: ADR-0005 Revisit-if 2 — enumeration separable from fetching
detail: GET /v1/blocks/{id}/children over a 151-block page returned 100 results with has_more true and a next_cursor, then 51 with has_more false, totalling 151 and matching the fixture exactly. The API distinguishes partial enumeration from resource fetch. The five-stage funnel's enumerated stage has an API basis and an unbounded gap is detectable. ADR-0005 decision 5 stands unchanged.

docs/research/notion-api-practice.md 5.2 claimed a child_page block stays visible in GET /v1/blocks/{id}/children with ID and title even when the page 404s on retrieve, calling it a named enumerable hole, rated (C), and flagged as the highest-value item to verify because a completeness proof would rest on it. Verified directly 2026-08-17. FALSE. After disconnecting the child, the parent returns 2 blocks instead of 3 and the child_page block is absent; the child 404s on pages, blocks, and blocks-children. Control via the full-access connector confirms the page still exists at the same ancestor path, so the list is permission-filtered rather than structurally changed. 5.2's detectable hole and undetectable hole are one case.

Earlier the same day, from the Notion UI disconnect dialog alone, it was recorded in docs/proof/fixture.md, the checkpoint and a gate event that unreached inside a declared root is reachable by permissions and that ADR-0005's evidence-sufficiency axis therefore keeps its full range. The API refutes it. Revocation removes the resource from enumeration entirely, so it never enters the applicable set and produces no gap to count. Inside a declared root, unreached arises only from rate limits, budget exhaustion, or abandoned pagination. Permissions yield a detectable gap only for an inaccessible declared root, and only because the operator declared it. The earlier gate event unverified_claim_confirmed remains in the log as written; this entry supersedes its third consequence. Lesson: a UI affordance is not an API behaviour.

REF001 becomes the load-bearing coverage mechanism. A link to an inaccessible page survives revocation because links live in page content, not in the permission-filtered child list. Confirmed: wl-outside-grant is linked from readable content and returns 404 on retrieve, which also confirms CONTEXT.md Principle 3's premise that an unconnected page returns 404 rather than 403. The general rule established: the coverage manifest can only name what the operator declared or what the tool successfully enumerated.

Ten issues sat in needs-triage since 2026-08-16 with no category role. Triage found six of them (#2 #3 #4 #5 #6 #9) were not open questions but undocumented decisions: store.json asserted_without_adr held an answer for each, matching the issue's own stated Default word for word. The tracker and the state file disagreed about what was settled. Consolidated into #16 (ready-for-agent, transcription into CONTEXT.md) and closed the six as duplicates with their problem statements intact. #1 and #7 to needs-info — both blocked on information outside the repo (five demand-test teams; a named reference workspace, REAL_ROOT_ID deliberately empty). #8 to ready-for-human as a brand choice. #10 stays needs-triage, blocked by #13.

Verified first that the existing PreToolUse file guard DID fire on ADR-0005 and passed it — an earlier claim that enforcement had not reached the ADR was wrong. The real gap was tracker writes: issues #13-#15 instruct a downstream reader on decisions, were created through Bash heredocs, and were seen by nothing. The UserPromptSubmit nudge keys on prompt text ('complete all github work' matches no pattern); the file guard keys on tool surface (never Edit/Write). New guard-downstream-framing-gh.py added to the PreToolUse Bash matcher. Validated against the three real bodies: all carried zero Revisit-if clauses and would have drawn the tier-2 reminder. Revisit-if sections were then added to all three by hand. The guard's first version blocked the commit installing it — unanchored command regex matched prose in a heredoc, and it scanned the whole command rather than the artifact body. Fixed by anchoring to shell command positions and splitting heredoc body from shell.

ADR-0002 decision 4 superseded in full; decisions 1, 2, 3 and 5 stand and ADR-0002 is not edited. Six decisions: (1) truncation is a positive test on request_status.type === 'incomplete', absence is neither an error nor proof of completeness; (2) a per-endpoint signal table -- the signal is documented on POST /v1/data_sources/{id}/query only, and is absent from /reference/intro#pagination and from GET /v1/blocks/{id}/children, which is the traversal spine of the scan and carries no truncation signal at all; (3) no fourth value on ADR-0005's evidence-sufficiency axis -- an absent field maps to sufficient, because the absent case has no remedy, fires on every run, and would train readers to discount the axis; (4) a cap-proximity lower-bound trip on the one endpoint with a documented cap, transplanted from Elasticsearch hits.total.relation 'gte', the OSIsoft PI Web API silent-truncation case and fetch n+1; (5) the mandatory sampling-risk statement now names the endpoints a run trusted blind, giving it per-run content; (6) the version pin stands as a floor, buying the possibility of the signal and a stable envelope for ADR-0004, not guaranteed presence. request_status.type === 'complete' has never been observed and no decision depends on it.

PRODUCT.md said the report states 'exactly what the scan could not see'. Narrowed to three provable claims -- declared-root coverage, link resolution, and the ambiguity of 404 -- and two stated unprovables: anything about permission removal below a declared root, and that a child list was complete. REF001 promoted in the text to the load-bearing coverage mechanism, because links live in page content rather than in the permission-filtered child list and so survive revocation. The refuted claim was found standing in a SECOND place in the same file: proof test 1 under 'Four proof tests the PRD does not list' asserted that partial-scan detectability rested on child_page survival. Marked ANSWERED and refuted rather than deleted, on the same reasoning that keeps superseded ADR text standing; tests 2, 3 and 4 got status lines. Issue #14 left OPEN deliberately -- it is labelled ready-for-human and the wording of a product claim is the operator's call. The draft is a proposal.

The inference that an absent request_status maps to ADR-0005's `unreached` was found standing in THREE surfaces, not one: docs/proof/results.md section 1 closing sentence, store.json corrections_pending[0].replacement which copied it forward verbatim, and by implication any code written from either. It is wrong because `unreached` carries the remedy 'widen access or raise the request budget' and no operator action produces a field the server declined to send. Corrected by reference in ADR-0006's header rather than by editing the evidence record; store.json corrected in place because it is forward-looking state, not a dated record. This is the second time this repository has produced the three-places pattern -- ADR-0005 found the refuted SARIF sentence in three files after a handoff claimed one. Treat 'the claim is in one place' as unverified until grepped.

The #15 verification pass refuted ADR-0006 decision 2 one day after it was accepted and hours after it merged. The table lists POST /v1/search as carrying no truncation signal. Notion's post-search reference documents request_status on the search response (type complete|incomplete, incomplete_reason query_result_limit_reached), and notion-sdk-js PR #711 adds the field to SearchResponse. docs/research/notion-api-practice.md section 4.5 had listed SearchResponse correctly since 2026-08-16, so the ADR contradicted a file already in the repository. METHOD FAILURE, and it is the reusable part: a negative was asserted across three endpoints having opened two, and silence on the shared pagination reference was read as absence rather than as not-checked. CONSEQUENCES: (1) the coverage story IMPROVES, because a truncated search is detectable and the ~11,200 wall becomes a reportable gap rather than a silent one; (2) ADR-0006's central finding SURVIVES and is better evidenced, because PR #711 threads the field through seven response types and omits ListBlockChildrenResponse, so the traversal spine's missing signal now rests on two independent sources. ADR-0006 is NOT edited. Superseding ADR tracked as #21, frontier tier.

Six settled defaults transcribed into a new CONTEXT.md 'Settled defaults' section; asserted_without_adr drops 7 entries to 1 (the survivor, validation shape n=1 build / n=3 release, was never part of #16). The rule catalogue gains a v0.1 column: four ship, four deferred and explicitly not cut. The issue's Revisit-if asked whether any of the six conflicts with a locked ADR. None does, but ONE INTERACTS and the interaction was unstated: ADR-0005 decision 4 makes exit status a function of report disposition and coverage ratio, so baseline fail-new-only governs the FINDINGS contribution alone and a scan can fail on coverage while every finding it produced is baselined. Both inputs are now named; the composition is filed as #20. Also corrected: CONTEXT.md's stop condition read 'a complete coverage manifest' with no declared-root qualifier, which is the wording that would stop the project on a fact ADR-0002 already settled. PRODUCT.md carried the identical defect and was corrected earlier; CONTEXT.md was the surviving copy. THIRD instance of the same refuted framing standing in more than one place. Artifacts split out rather than forced into the glossary: #18 hydration map, #19 identity rule, #20 baseline state machine.

checkpoint.md 445 -> 140 lines (-69%); bands S001-S005 archived verbatim to .claude/state/checkpoint-archive.md. The cut required a structural repair first, and it is a new failure mode. Each band ended with a pointer at the band before it, so archiving any band in the chain breaks every reference above it while losing ZERO normative claims. The claim-level superset check cannot see this: the content survives in the archive and only reachability dies. Fixed by hoisting the cautions into one canonical Standing constraints block, then cutting. HOISTING FROM THE OLDEST SOURCE recovered two constraints the newest band had already silently dropped: the living-docs carve-out on 'ADRs are never edited in place', and the scouts rule that a self-nominated soft claim prioritises verification but never bounds it. The chain was lossy BEFORE the archive; the archive exposed it. Written into the context-hygiene skill as step 2 plus a Correctness-hardening recognizer, which then fired on that same file, because inserting the step renumbered the list and left one reference pointing at the wrong step. NOTE: the skill edit is UNCOMMITTED in ~/.claude on operator instruction; that repo is not to be touched.

ADR-0007 accepted, superseding ONE ROW of ADR-0006 decision 2's per-endpoint table. POST /v1/search DOES carry a truncation signal: request_status with type complete|incomplete and incomplete_reason query_result_limit_reached, confirmed by the post-search reference and notion-sdk-js PR #711, both re-fetched directly for the ADR rather than inherited from the issue. ADR-0006 is not edited and its decisions 1, 3, 4, 5 and 6 stand; the other two rows of its table stand. Three findings beyond the correction. (1) The error was INERT -- decision 1's positive test means the scan never consults the table to decide whether to look for the field, so a wrong None gated nothing and behaviour is unchanged either way. Containment by luck, explicitly not treated as a defence. (2) The coverage consequence is CONDITIONAL: no document in the repo gives search a role in a v0.1 scan. Five design surfaces opened and all five silent; the ADR states the silence and refuses the negative, filing #24. (3) The fact stood in TWO research files three hours before ADR-0006, not one -- notion-api-practice.md 4.5 and competitive-landscape.md 4, 12106c5@18:51 vs f8917fa@21:42. Second ADR-vs-research contradiction; enforcement decision filed as #25 rather than installed. ADR-0006's central finding STRENGTHENED: block-children carrying no signal moved from documentation silence to an enumerated omission, PR #711 threading request_status through seven response types and skipping ListBlockChildrenResponse. Evidence class stated in the ADR rather than buried: both sources for the corrected row are statements of intent, no capped search has been observed, and neither branch of request_status has been seen on any endpoint. This is the class that produced ADR-0002 decision 4.

Exit status specified as a priority signal over two axes with precedence 4>2>3>1>0. Exit 2 widened from ADR-0002's unreachable-declared-root to the disclaimed disposition, which ADR-0005 decision 3 had already named as the general form, so ADR-0002's number is untouched. Bit mask rejected. Exit 0 carries a two-part invariant: no new unsuppressed finding, and coverage at or above the declared threshold. Baseline model split into two axes with five baseline states and suppression orthogonal. resolved requires the (rule,resource) pair to have reached the manifest's evaluated stage.

Internal integration is the primary credential model. Operator defined as the accountability locus for the access boundary, split from Executor and Consumer; roles distinct, people may coincide. PAT gated as a secondary mode requiring a Principal in the manifest. Membership drift under a fixed principal declared undetectable and disclosed rather than detected, because no endpoint returns a user's accessible set. Closes #1 narrowly -- the buyer half was untracked by the auto-close and refiled as #29.

Checked directly against guides/get-started/overview on 2026-08-17 as part of the #27 sweep. No endpoint lists the content a token can reach, for any connection type, and search is not documented as exhaustive. Neither condition fired. The declared-root coverage model stands and everything built on it is unaffected by the Developer Platform launch.

Fingerprint matching was adopted as 'two entries are logically identical when any one key matches', which is not transitive. Taking the transitive closure merges unrelated findings; not taking it makes matching order-dependent and violates ADR-0004. Fix is priority-ordered probing -- a deterministic total function rather than a relation. Needs a superseding ADR; ADR-0008 is not edited. Found by checking algebraic properties rather than evidence, which is the discipline gap the operator named the same session.

notion-user-pain.md section 4 records that structural rot is a chronic irritation with no published damage account, while broken integrations produce panic and quantified loss. The mechanism is named verbatim by Sundararajan: the execution log still shows green, and that is the part that makes it hard to catch. Every high-intensity item in the repository is the same defect class -- has_more lying at 10,000 rows, permission-filtered child lists, block-children carrying no truncation signal, relations truncating at 25, formulas returning unsupported, grep -q exiting 0 after an error. The product is an anti-false-green instrument, not a tidiness linter. Not yet an ADR; recorded as the session's largest finding pending the rule-catalogue re-read.

Merged as e41261a via PR #32. Closes #31. Matching is now a hierarchy of matchkeys over a (rule, resource) anchor, run as ordered passes with one-to-one pool removal; transitive closure is prohibited; the observed value is evidence and never identity. Three CONTEXT.md glossary rows corrected in place. ADR-0008 not edited.

gate: #25 -- a fourth shape the three method rules do not catch
detail: ADR-0008 decision 6 contradicts ADR-0003 decision 1. Rule 1's grep targets docs/research/, so an ADR contradicting an EARLIER ADR returns nothing and cannot be caught by it. Recorded as its own shape on #25 rather than folded into that issue's count, which counts ADRs contradicting research files. If the grep becomes a PreToolUse hook it covers one of four shapes as currently specified.

Dependencies approved by the operator after the ASK FIRST gate was surfaced. @notionhq/client 5.25.2, typescript 7.0.2, tsx 4.23.12, all verified to exist per section 12 before install. Toolchain and node_modules live on the throwaway branch proto/ref001-observed only; main is still pre-build with no src/ and no package.json.

certainty confirmed, target_state unreachable, on a link discovered from content rather than a supplied ID. Disposition qualified, coverage 3/4, exit 3. ADR-0008 decision 2's priority order observed firing: a confined gap below threshold outranks a new finding, so coverage outranks conformity in the byte.

The host allow-list was /notion.(so|site)/ and the fixture's own link is served from app.notion.com. Zero links discovered, no error, and the run would have reported a clean unqualified verdict over a root containing a dead link. It appeared to pass only because a synthetic control injected the known-bad ID directly. Filed as #34. The general rule: a link recogniser has three outcomes and the third is unrecognised.

The sweep ran before the instrument was specified, as the rule requires, and it changed the answer rather than confirming it. Notion Help documents custom domains for Notion Sites, so a Notion page can be served from a domain Notion does not own. The host allow-list is therefore provably incompletable rather than merely unverified, which satisfies #34's own first Revisit-if before the spec was written and promotes the unrecognised residue path from a safety net to the primary mechanism. The soundiness manifesto (Livshits et al., CACM 58(2), February 2015, DOI 10.1145/2644805) supplied the general principle: enumerate and publish the unhandled set; a caveat that lurks in the shadows lets a reader erroneously conclude the analysis is sound.

gate: #34 -- is an unrecognised link a new value on ADR-0005's evidence-sufficiency axis
detail: No. It is `undecidable`. The remedies are identical, and the project's deletion test deletes any value whose remedy duplicates another's. #34's counter-argument -- the tool does not know whether a resource exists at all -- is a genuine epistemic difference that changes no operator action, so it is a manifest cause, which ADR-0005 decision 5 constraint 2 already requires. Corroborated by XCCDF 1.1.4's notchecked/unknown split and by LinkChecker's shipping handler. ADR-0005's axis stands unchanged.

The 34-assertion suite written to satisfy the spec's own section 6 failed on its first run against section 5, which had claimed exit 0 was reachable by raising the coverage threshold. ADR-0008 decision 2 fires exit 1 on a new unsuppressed SYS001 finding, so only baselining the gap reaches exit 0. Fixed in c9eb5d0. Second consecutive session in which the artifact was correct and an instrument built to serve it was not -- the pattern S010 flagged to watch. Here the instrument caught itself.

gate: #36 -- the applicable set is defined over resources but REF001's is edges and UNQ001's is neither
detail: ADR-0011 makes the unit a per-rule declaration (coverage item) and the coverage ratio a vector whose headline is the minimum. Supersedes ADR-0005 decision 4's ratio definition, ADR-0008 decision 4's --min-coverage referent, and the coverage clause of ADR-0008 decision 2's exit-0 invariant; neither ADR edited. A conflict sweep over 37 hits in 9 files confirmed ADR-0009's 'coverage denominator is the integration's granted scope' and ADR-0002's declared-root denominator are a different sense of the word and do not collide. Chose minimum over mean because a mean lets a covered rule mask an uncovered one, which is the Great Expectations defect ADR-0005 decision 4 already prohibits.

gate: triage-role labels were documented in docs/agents/triage-labels.md and enforced nowhere
detail: 4 of 12 open issues carried enhancement and no role; every one was filed mid-session as a follow-up, and every issue filed as deliberate triage work had a role. Wrote guard-gh-issue-triage-label.py, a PreToolUse block on gh issue create that reads the role vocabulary from the project's own triage-labels.md rather than hardcoding it, and no-ops on projects without that file. 11 of 11 tests pass including a mutation check: in a fixture project declaring different label strings the guard rejects this repo's roles and accepts the fixture's, which proves the vocabulary comes from the file. Wired into ~/.claude/settings.json, which is gitignored, so the wiring is machine-local -- the same constraint #25 records. This is a working precedent for #25's option 2.

S010 and S011 both listed '#14 correct PRODUCT.md, still ahead of any outbound send' as the step in front of Gate 1. #14 was completed on 2026-08-16 in cc16d63, on origin/main, with every DoD element present in the issue's own wording; PRODUCT.md in the working tree is identical to it. Closed as complete. The actual Gate 1 blocker is a SEPARATE PRODUCT.md correction recorded only in store.json corrections_pending -- the demand test at section 110 and the kill criterion at section 152 both name the auditor buyer, whose refutation is conditional on ADR-0005 decision 3's unexamined 'cannot be sized' claim. It was marked blocks:Gate 1 and existed on no issue for three sessions. Filed as #40.

gate: #10 -- ratify the 72-hour proof result before any build starts
detail: Moved needs-triage -> ready-for-human. Both blockers named in its 2026-08-17 02:33 comment have cleared: #21 closed with ADR-0007 at 280524e, and the un-runnable checklist item was confirmed live in its only achievable form at ba25b7a. The third problem is structural: six of nine proof checks require the build the issue exists to gate, so it is unsatisfiable in the order it prescribes. Checks 3, 5, 6 and 7 recorded as build-acceptance criteria rather than pre-build gate criteria. Four stale body lines recorded for correction, including a stop condition missing the declared-root qualifier -- the FOURTH surface of a correction already applied to PRODUCT.md and CONTEXT.md and filed against README.md as #39.

The guard shipped matching the phrase anywhere in the Bash command string. It then blocked a legitimate state-file write whose JSON payload merely DESCRIBED the guard, inside a heredoc. Over-firing is not a safe failure mode: a guard that blocks unrelated commands gets switched off, and a switched-off guard protects nothing. Fixed by stripping heredoc bodies and requiring the match at a command position -- start of string or after a shell separator, optionally preceded by env assignments. Suite grew 11 -> 16 with three regression cases (heredoc body, quoted argument, grep pattern) and is now self-contained at ~/.claude/hooks/test_guard_gh_issue_triage_label.py, building its own fixture projects. The mutation check survived the rewrite.
